[{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Hey Amanda, how have you been lately?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've been feeling a mix of emotions recently. My parents visited me last weekend, and it stirred up a lot of feelings."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable that a visit from your parents could bring up a lot of emotions. How did it go overall?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Overall, it was nice to see them. I hadn't realized just how much I missed them."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Reconnecting with family can be really comforting. Did you get to talk about anything meaningful with them?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yes, we talked a lot about my childhood and some of the happier times. They even shared some old stories that I had forgotten."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds really special. It’s great they brought back those memories for you."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It was. But it also made me realize how much I've changed, and how stressed I've been lately with everything going on."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Change can be overwhelming, especially when stress is involved. Is there any specific stress that's been bothering you?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Work has been really stressful. My supervisor still doesn't value my contributions, even after the promotion."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I remember you mentioned your supervisor's behavior in the past. It must be tough feeling undervalued even as you rise in your career."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It is. I worked so hard for that promotion, but it only seems to have increased my anxiety."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's really challenging. Have you been able to find ways to manage your work stress?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've tried painting and other hobbies, but I end up putting pressure on myself to excel even in those."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like you might be putting a lot of pressure on yourself in different areas. What do you feel when you paint?"}]

I know it might be a difficult conversation to have, but it is often good to get expectations out in the open so you are on the same page with your partner. \\nseeker: Yes, sort of and he gave me the impression that he is not there yet and that was a like almost a year ago, I don't want it to look like I'm pushing him if I try to talk to him again about it.
